candidates.name: OpenProcessToken
verified_facts: Opens the access token associated with a process
Requested token rights and process query rights are explicit
semantic_limits: A token handle alone does not prove the process is the canonical runner or that the token is current.

candidates.name: GetTokenInformation
verified_facts: Retrieves a selected class of access-token information
The required buffer size can be discovered before readback
semantic_limits: Successful readback does not establish task ownership, freshness, or receipt validity.

candidates.name: TOKEN_INFORMATION_CLASS
verified_facts: Defines token information classes used by GetTokenInformation
Classes include elevation, integrity, owner, groups, privileges, and statistics
semantic_limits: A class identifier does not validate the returned buffer or its relationship to the expected process.

candidates.name: TOKEN_ELEVATION
verified_facts: Represents whether a token is elevated
The state is queried through token information APIs
semantic_limits: Elevation is not proof of authorization, correctness, or canonical runner ownership.

candidates.name: TOKEN_ELEVATION_TYPE
verified_facts: Distinguishes default, full, and limited elevation token types
The value is returned through GetTokenInformation
semantic_limits: Elevation type does not prove the intended executable, task, or receipt producer.

candidates.name: TOKEN_USER
verified_facts: Carries the user SID associated with an access token
SID attributes accompany the user identity
semantic_limits: A matching user SID does not prove the exact process instance or command line.

candidates.name: TOKEN_GROUPS
verified_facts: Lists group SIDs and their attributes in a token
Attributes distinguish enabled, deny-only, mandatory, and owner-capable groups
semantic_limits: Group presence without attribute checks can overstate effective authorization.

candidates.name: TOKEN_GROUPS_AND_PRIVILEGES
verified_facts: Combines group, restricted SID, privilege, and authentication identifiers
Counts and lengths are explicit
semantic_limits: Composite token data still requires exact PID, start-time, image, and task correlation.

candidates.name: TOKEN_PRIVILEGES
verified_facts: Lists token privileges and their attributes
Attributes show enabled, default, removed, and used-for-access states
semantic_limits: Possessing a privilege does not mean it was enabled or used for the recovery action.

candidates.name: TOKEN_OWNER
verified_facts: Identifies the default owner SID associated with a token
The SID must already be present in the token
semantic_limits: Default token ownership is not the same as file, task, process, or receipt ownership.

candidates.name: TOKEN_PRIMARY_GROUP
verified_facts: Identifies the token primary-group SID
The structure is retrievable through token information APIs
semantic_limits: Primary group identity alone does not establish effective access or execution ownership.

candidates.name: TOKEN_DEFAULT_DACL
verified_facts: Carries the default DACL used for newly created objects
The ACL is associated with the token
semantic_limits: A default DACL does not describe existing receipt files or prove their final ACLs.

candidates.name: TOKEN_STATISTICS
verified_facts: Provides token identifiers, authentication ID, type, impersonation level, and counts
Statistics can distinguish token instances
semantic_limits: Token statistics are insufficient without process start time, image path, and task identity.

candidates.name: TOKEN_MANDATORY_LABEL
verified_facts: Carries the mandatory integrity label SID and attributes
It is returned for the token integrity-level information class
semantic_limits: Integrity level does not imply administrator rights or permission to mutate canonical state.

candidates.name: CheckTokenMembership
verified_facts: Checks whether a SID is present and enabled in an effective token
Deny-only and disabled SIDs are not treated as grant-capable membership
semantic_limits: Membership checks do not replace a complete access check for the target object.
